Jeffrey and Gary.

Hcrc is the revised schedule we are proposing:



Main Residence:

• Yesterday we sent Gary a draft of the stair from the main residence, past the kitchen, to the master
bedroom and road. We wanted Gary to review it first, before we sent it out, to make sure we captured all
of the comments and conditions, but the sketches arc attached.

• We will updated drafts of the living room and enclosed pool mid-next week. We arc incorporating the
changes we discussed over the phone with Jeffrey.



Flagpole Pool:




                                                                                                EFTA_R1_00208908
                                                                                                     EFTA01830560
 • We are laying this pool out, based on the sketches we received. Tom is also working on some alternate
layouts. We will try to send this out also mid-next week. (Jeffrey, did you have any reference images you
liked for this open-air pool?)



Spa and Guest Cottage:

• We put these two buildings on hold as asked, to focus on the two areas above. We will pick back up
on conceptual sketches for these areas after we send you the Main Residence and Flagpole pool.



Some of the team will be out for a bit around Christmas and New Year, but we will continue to send
progress work back and forth, and have calls to discuss this with you. Our thought was to prepare for a
detailed presentation and work session on the Island, for all areas, mid-January, perhaps during the week of
1/17/11. Please let me know if that will work.



Thanks,

Warwick
